quotes.name: Marcus Whitfield
quotes.quote: I've seen how community programs can really bring people together and make a difference in their lives. As someone who's founded a program myself, I know how much work and dedication goes into making it happen. It's not just about the program itself, but about the people behind it and the impact it has on the community.

quotes.name: Maria Conteras
quotes.quote: I've seen that community programs in East Oakland are really making a difference, and it's great to see people like Marcus Whitfield founding initiatives that help our neighborhood.

quotes.name: Jerome Pittman
quotes.quote: I feel like community programs and their founders in East Oakland are really making a difference, I see the impact they have on people's lives around here.
